plugin.name: Mafia: Definitive Edition Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Goes straight on past the middleware logos, the disclaimer page and the 2K and Hangar 13 logo movie. Off shows them as in the original game. Needs a restart.
SkipPressStart.description: Goes from the title straight to the main menu, without the "Press Enter to start" screen. First-time settings still appear.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Choose the language used for the fix’s settings text. Auto follows the game or editor language.
